patch_description: Adds eight reusable per-wire offset parameters to the three collective rotation layers while retaining the complete-graph CZ entangler. Consecutive same-axis rotations implement \(R_a(\theta_{\mathrm{collective}}+\theta_{\mathrm{offset},i})\) exactly within the existing schema, so no fixed interpreter or training code is changed. This preserves the regularizing collective backbone while allowing modest qubit-specific corrections for residual feature-map asymmetries.
